# ResolveSchema

## Rules
- Deps: SchemaRegistry, schemaRef, workspaceSchemasPaths, schemaPlugins[], schemaOverrides?. `execute()` no args.
- Pipeline: (1) resolve base — null→SchemaNotFoundError; (2) recursive extends + cycle detect→SchemaValidationError; (3) extends layers root→parent `source:'extends'`; (4) plugins must `kind:schema-plugin` else SchemaValidationError; (5) normalize override hooks YAML→domain recursively, layer `source:'override'`; (6) mergeSchemaLayers; (7) if layers: pre-merge buildSchema on inherited for base-error attribution; (8) buildSchema — with layers ref `"<schemaRef> (resolved)"` else schemaRef. Child templates override parent same path.
- Returns `Promise<Schema>`. Idempotent, deterministic. Config factory via `resolveResolveSchemaDeps`.

## Constraints
- application/use-cases/; domain services + SchemaRegistry only — no infra imports. Plugin miss = hard error. Extends unlimited depth, cycles detected.
